history.summary: CSV row 'Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Godhra' maps to the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir at 101 Ramnagar Society, Amdavad Road, Godhra — the well-documented Swaminarayan temple in the town, listed on the official BAPS global network and rated 4.6 (Justdial, ~490 ratings). Godhra also has an SMVS Swaminarayan temple on Dahod Road, so the generic CSV name is ambiguous between the two; the BAPS mandir is the larger, better-documented one. No publicly documented consecration date or founding history for the Godhra BAPS mandir was found (BAPS was founded by Shastriji Maharaj; the Akshar-Purushottam tradition's sixth guru is Mahant Swami Maharaj). Coordinates are from corroborated place listings at the documented address.

name: BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Godhra
town_description: Godhra is the administrative headquarters of Panchmahal district in eastern Gujarat and a major railway junction. The town is a noted Vaishnav centre, hosting four Pushtimarg bethaks, and has a layered Hindu, Jain and Muslim heritage.

travel.airport: Vadodara Airport (~110 km southwest); Ahmedabad Airport (~140 km west)
travel.railway: Godhra Junction (GDA), on the Delhi-Mumbai line
travel.road: On Amdavad Road (Ahmedabad-Godhra road), near Bhuravav; the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway passes through Godhra

visitor_information.opening_hours: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM daily (per BAPS and Justdial listings)
